person1_text: He consults with boards of directors and management on the design of modern human resource processes that align with their business strategy. He consults with businesses and individuals as a strategic advisor and coach. His work focuses on talent development processes and succession systems in particular. He has been operating a coaching program based on the DNLA Expert System since 2009. He is also a co-author of I4F, an organizational culture analysis model and a competency model for successful performance in a digital business context.
person2_text: A professional with extensive knowledge of organizational climate, culture, and employee engagement. He consults organizations in the public and private sector on transforming organizational culture and upgrading HR processes. He consults, facilitates, and coaches individuals using DNLA programs. He is also one of the co-founders of I4F, a system for analysing organizational culture in the digital economy.
person3_text: He joined Resultant in 2019. He is responsible for communication between prospective clients and our consultants and assists with the preparation of analyses, research, and testing reports. He also helps during workshops and in the process of potential and competency assessment.
